summary: Independent Q6 rebuild on task_commit 04d792a8 finds a reachable, coupled sovereign RDS control-plane runtime rather than import-only padding. Operator entrypoints rdsctl/rdsd/rds-worker/generate-estate reach cli, FastAPI app, worker, and fixture generation; those hubs transitively import and invoke instance lifecycle, failover lease/VIP, replica/LSN fencing, parameter-group orchestration, WAL/PITR, outbox dispatch, and PostgreSQL persistence. Static reachability yields ~3341 substantive Python LOC across 47 modules plus ~256 config/SQL/bin LOC (~3597 combined), clearing the large_system_strict >=3000 floor. Core modules carry branching, state transitions, and intentional starter defects on live paths. Thin helpers exist but are small (~170 LOC) and on call paths; toy/padding risk is not HIGH. Removing ~25% of the reachable core would drop promote/failover/PITR/outbox/parameter behavior or break cross-module invariants.

evidence.observation: Q6 requires independent entrypoint reachability, module diversity, coupling, removal impact, and toy/padding judgment; raw LOC or other gate verdicts are not sufficient alone.

Estate generator entrypoint reaches fixture_generator for representative multi-thousand-row control-plane state.
Operator commands (list/health/snapshot/promote/failover) construct InstanceManager, SnapshotManager, readiness/audit/authorization helpers and call repository/manager methods.
REST surface wires instance create/modify/delete, snapshots, PITR restore, parameter-group modify, maintenance, readiness, pool monitor, KMS, and scaling into the same managers used by the CLI.
Background loop processes outbox events through dispatcher, notification service, subscription routing, audit recording, and failover lease heartbeat.

Central lifecycle hub (~476 substantive LOC) with status fencing, checkpoint/outbox staging, parameter pending-reboot cache, promote_read_replica, and execute_failover. Starter defects sit inside these live methods; failover/replica/replication/VIP leaves are constructed and called rather than import-only.
Lease acquire/validate, health-probe isolation via ConnectionPoolMonitor, and VIP migration via VIPManager are callable from instance_manager failover; method names match call sites.
Promotion validation and write-lease revoke are invoked from promote_read_replica and couple into ReplicationEngine LSN helpers while retaining intentional lag/lease traps.
Create/modify/classify paths validate against ParameterCatalog and ParameterGroupManager; reachable from the API parameter endpoints.
Large but domain-legitimate PostgreSQL parameter dictionary with apply_type/data_type/range validation consumed by the orchestrator; counted as runtime/config substance, not decorative docs.
PITR plan synthesis validates windows, selects base snapshots, filters WAL, and couples WALCollector/WALPlaybackSimulator/CoverageAnalyzer; invoked from app restore_pitr.
Event identifier, subscription filter, and payload formatting used by instance_manager enqueue paths and worker dispatch.
Async PostgreSQL repository methods back list/get/update/outbox/subscription operations used by CLI, app, and worker.
Normalized schema for instances, parameter groups, snapshots, WAL archives, failover leases, outbox, and subscriptions; matches runtime queries rather than inert DDL padding.
Pinned Postgres 16 plus rds-api and rds-worker services sharing DATABASE_URL and state volumes; multi-process control plane rather than a single script toy.
Deterministic estate generator sized for ~100 instances and ~14k WAL archive rows plus snapshots; state volume feeds PITR/coverage/list paths rather than opaque filler blobs.

PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing only instance status checks can still leave promote failing on lag/LSN or write-lease revoke defects in replica/replication leaves.
Fixing failover lease acquire without health-probe isolation or VIP route-flush/ARP semantics can still fail Multi-AZ fencing invariants.
Fixing parameter apply classification without catalog validation or reboot pending-static application can still leave modify/reboot inconsistent.
Fixing PITR window bounds without WAL continuity/playback coupling can still produce incomplete restore plans.
Fixing outbox identifier hashing without worker retry/FAILED audit and subscription source-type filtering can still break deterministic EventBridge outputs.
Checkpoint/outbox staging defects in instance_manager can leave API-visible success without durable operation records even if status transitions look correct.
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of reachable core cannot be dead-weight deletion. Dropping instance_manager promote/failover sections eliminates HA workflows; dropping parameter catalog/orchestrator removes apply-mode correctness; dropping PITR/WAL modules removes restore synthesis; dropping event outbox/worker dispatch removes notification determinism; dropping repository/SQL breaks persistence for all operators. Thin helpers are too small to explain the LOC floor; the coupled hubs and domain leaves carry the behavior.
